title: A note on efficient k-limited broadcast domination in graphs
summary: An efficient $k$-limited dominating broadcast, or $k$-ELDB, is a $k$-limited broadcast in which every vertex is dominated exactly once. This notion brings together efficient domination and limited broadcast domination in a common framework. For a graph $G$, we write $mcr(G)$ for the smallest integer $k$ for which $G$ admits a $k$-ELDB. For an admissible value $k\ge mcr(G)$, we denote by $γ_{ebk}(G)$ the minimum cost of a $k$-ELDB on $G$, and is called the $k$-efficient broadcast domination number of $G$.
